rationale: The assistant unplugged first, used the customer's 'slight squeak/scrape and feels a little rough' finding correctly, and kept the diagnosis appropriately hedged between jockey pulley/belt and drum rollers/bearing without false certainty. It escalated to an engineer sensibly once the customer said they could not tilt or lift the drum due to a bad back. Weaknesses: it never asked for the model number, never tried the simplest check of levelling the feet on the wooden floor, and did not ask where the noise seemed to come from or consider the condensate pump, so the diagnostic path was shorter than it could have been.
